title: Nice but a few things…
body: Love the overall idea and cuteness, but I get very annoyed by too many long time windows and too many questions. When I open the app I just want to go to my list immediately (the mood tracker is ok, but maybe to leave it as an option to check). Maybe some activities in the house or during the travel connected to mental health would be good, but again not as something you’re forced to do
